preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines: the first line is an integer n, and the second line is the string s.
The integer n equals the length of string s, and n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in lines[1])
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a single string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(encoded_chars[i] == s[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output string, when encoded using the median-deletion process, produces the input string s exactly.
